audits.decision_reason: All checklist criteria satisfied: variables are measurable (baseline heart rate, respiration rate, morphology), causal chain links baseline variability to distribution shift and coverage drift, confounders (age, medication, SNR) identified, data requirements clearly specified (multi-subject ECG with baseline measures, ≥20 subjects, segment length ≥30s, sampling ≥250Hz), mechanism is non-generic due to specific physiological variables and boundary conditions (healthy adults at rest, segment length ≥30s, sampling ≥250Hz), prediction is testable via linear mixed-effects model of coverage deviation on baseline variability score.
